structure.unit: Waters of the State, Ports and Harbors

law.text: For the purposes of this chapter: "Committee" means the Potomac Aquifer Recharge Oversight Committee established pursuant to § 62.1-272. "Department" means the Department of Environmental Quality. "HRSD" means the Hampton Roads Sanitation District. "Laboratory" means the Potomac Aquifer Recharge Monitoring Laboratory established pursuant to § 62.1-274. "SWIFT Project" means the Sustainable Water Initiative for Tomorrow Project conducted by HRSD.
